minor.issue: 4 tests fail intermittently when run with xdist -n auto due to shared /api/demo state races (test_jrn13_speed_recomputes, test_jrn36_38_accept_undo_stale, test_jrn42_fleet_and_unit_stats, test_jrn43_bad_job_input). All pass sequentially (-o addopts=''). Suggest removing `-n auto` default or marking state-mutating tests with @pytest.mark.serial and running them in a serial group.

action_items: Low priority: reconfigure pytest default addopts to avoid xdist parallelism on stateful demo endpoints, OR split suites into serial/parallel groups so CI reflects the real green state (46/46).

rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues. The parallel pytest flakes RCA: tests mutate shared singleton demo state (settings, jobs, clock) via /api/demo/reset per-test; xdist workers execute these tests concurrently, so one worker's reset wipes another worker's just-prepared state (e.g. test_jrn13 sees spare 50→50 instead of a decrease; test_jrn43 gets 502 because its job id was wiped mid-test; test_jrn42 gets an empty response). Mitigation: enforce serial execution for integration tests that depend on shared demo state.
